strategy_description: Triggers when a coin drops more than 10% in 24 hours. Large single-day drops tend to mean-revert within 3-7 days due to short covering and bargain hunting. Tighter targets and stops than extreme_fear because crash bounces are faster but less reliable.
strategy_edge: Short squeeze + bargain hunting after >10% daily drop
